Sales results for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥2,160 million, and as of December 31, 2025, the number of registered real estate businesses and others was 1,491.
entries.92d088b17fd465ef: This is 'Shataku Rakku NAVI,' a cloud service that supports the housing search, moving, and company housing management of transferred employees on behalf of corporations. It includes 'One Coin Transfer Company Housing,' which outsources company housing management, 'Benefit Company Housing,' which introduces company housing systems as a welfare benefit, and 'Heya Wari,' a sublease service offering rent discounts. Sales results for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥1,877 million, and as of December 31, 2025, the number of registered corporations and others was 4,016.

entries.becfb0f26bdc92f6: This is a single-segment business that supports procedures related to a new life through the 'New Life Service Platform,' including arranging housing and moving, arranging utilities such as electricity, gas, water, and internet, supporting job transfers, and assisting in introducing company housing systems.
entries.e00d35a26137c786: This consists of the platform 'HAKOPLA,' which matches cases between moving companies and idle trucks and personnel, and 'Hikkoshi Rakku NAVI' for individuals. It also provides the dedicated moving business core system 'HAKO-Tec' and cardboard advertising 'HAKO-Ad.' Sales results for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥325 million, and as of December 31, 2025, there were 158 participating moving companies and 64,946 matched cases.
